definition.name: Actual signed Go condition, lock, select and retirement controls

steps.name: Install pinned repository source controls
Check finite source and fail-closed execution contracts
Check exact cross-tenant admission evidence controls
Check exact queued-root reservation and original-deadline evidence controls
Check exact managed-v5 standard timer and GC evidence controls
Check original Task16 saturation evidence controls
Check exact Go timer overlap evidence controls
Check fired timer evidence controls
Check exact zero-clock timer evidence controls
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_go_zero_clock -v
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --test local_service fixture::zero_clock_load_tests::fixture_load_uses_the_injected_admission_clock -- --exact --show-output | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-zero-clock-load-check.log"
grep -Fx 'test fixture::zero_clock_load_tests::fixture_load_uses_the_injected_admission_clock ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-zero-clock-load-check.log"
grep -Eq '^test result: ok[.] 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; [0-9]+ filtered out;' "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-zero-clock-load-check.log"

steps.name: Install captured compiler namespace
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Install the exact maintained compiler and generator
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
cargo install --git https://github.com/bytecodealliance/componentize-go --rev 148dba505f8c6c64ad84db777cfde5e34e25098b --locked componentize-go
test "$(wasm-tools --version | cut -d ' ' -f 1,2)" = 'wasm-tools 1.254.0'
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-synchronization-tools"
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-synchronization-tools/go.tar.gz" https://dl.google.com/go/go1.27.3.linux-amd64.tar.gz
echo "65efbc80fdc1fa2cd2631cad5b481777a68e8725f34e89f50fc6ac714e379b40  $RUNNER_TEMP/go-synchronization-tools/go.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-synchronization-tools/go.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-synchronization-tools"
python3 tools/go_guest/runtime.py --prepare-compiler "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-synchronization-tools/go" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-synchronization-tools/go-async"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-synchronization-tools/go-async/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

Require one original signed timer wait across the shared zero-origin edge
Require signed ticker coalescing on the same bounded clock
Retain bounded actual results and compiler source identities

reviewReason: Add one opt-in signed Task16 saturation and original typed journal refusal lane; preserve the existing synchronization, timer and queue campaigns. Require Go before the existing timer host controls. Retain prior campaigns; bind each overlap fixture to its own profile, source revision and diagnostics. Reject foreign token probes and retain diagnostic source, component and signed results. Select the existing v7 timer source, owner and retained receipt without changing limits. Retain the two extra diagnostic overlays and exact Go channel inputs. Add one exact zero-clock-v7 fixture and fail-closed owner without changing the existing cases. Run one exact zero-clock load-domain control before the unchanged signed witness. Reuse that same component for one independent bounded ticker-coalescing case.
